description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data within the Darija Open Dataset, specifically showing the counts for different data types. The chart contains five slices, each representing a category of data. The largest slice, colored green, is labeled “Pending Translations” and represents 45,387 data points. Next is a blue slice labeled “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” with a count of 30,000. A grey slice labeled “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)” represents 23,108 data points. A smaller orange slice is labeled “Moroccan Names” and a very small red slice is labeled “Extra + Augmented Data”. The chart includes a legend identifying each color with its corresponding data type, and numerical values are displayed directly within the green, blue, and grey slices. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest based on their numerical values.
